transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. I've called us together because we have an incident involving unauthorized access to a customer-facing system, and the incident-response team has completed its initial review. As it stands, we have no SEC Form 8-K drafted for this incident on our current filing calendar, and the board's regular meeting is tomorrow. The company wants any required public filing approved before that meeting. Under our board-approved communications process, I need a final recommendation from each of you — cybersecurity, privacy, and investor-relations — before I can authorize an external filing. I also want to flag that our existing draft communications use general language about an investigation and do not yet specify the incident's regulatory classification, affected-account count, detailed operational impact, or ransom-demand treatment. The final filing package must be complete before external authorization. So let's start with cybersecurity: can you give us your assessment and your final recommendation on whether we need to file an 8-K?
